title: Long-time Stability and Convergence of Particle Swarm Optimization
summary: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is a global optimization algorithm defined by an interacting set of particles evolving over the search space. Heuristically motivated, its theoretical analysis remains limited due to the second-order, stochastic, and highly nonlinear nature of the dynamics. In this paper, we connect classical PSO stability analysis under the stagnation assumption with more recent mean-field methods, providing new quantitative estimates for the time-discrete algorithm.
